segments.title: Chương 295: Người Đông, Cút!
segments.content:
On the third day of the Lunar New Year, Chen Guiliang returned home from Great-Grandmother's. On the fourth, a large group of relatives from the city came down.

They were all relatives from his grandfather's side.

Among them was a cousin's second husband, who was also the number three at a certain salt factory.

Longdu was also known as the Salt Capital, producing salt everywhere, with a great number of salt factories. Right now, they were all operating at a loss, mainly due to policy reasons. It wouldn't matter who was the factory director.

This cousin-in-law had brought another official with him, the director of investment promotion for Longdu's High-Tech Zone.

Don't be fooled by Longdu's poverty, they really did have a High-Tech Zone.

Moreover, it was planned in 1990 and approved in 1992, making it the first high-tech development zone in the entire Sichuan province. Even earlier than Rongcheng and Shancheng!

At that time, Shancheng was still under the jurisdiction of Sichuan province.

"Hello, Boss Chen. My name is Sun Yuejin. I'm here today in a private capacity to offer New Year's greetings." This investment promotion director shook Chen Guiliang's hand enthusiastically.

What was he here for?

To attract investment, of course!

The cousin-in-law, whose name was Yu Jianguo, said with a smile, "Director Sun and I are old friends. This time, when he heard I was coming to visit relatives, he wanted to tag along, saying he wanted to see the results of the new rural construction."

Chen Guiliang wasn't very familiar with this cousin-in-law.

He and the cousin were both on their second marriage, having only been married for six or seven years. During that time, he had only come to the countryside twice, and he was quite an elusive figure.

In Chen Guiliang's other life, right after he graduated, his parents were afraid he wouldn't find a job. They had quietly asked this cousin-in-law to get Chen Guiliang a job at the local daily newspaper.

The cousin-in-law agreed, but Chen Guiliang didn't come back, having found a job at a newspaper in a big city on his own.

Chen Guiliang reached into his pocket to offer a cigarette, but Director Sun quickly preempted him, holding out a cigarette with both hands and presenting it to Chen Guiliang.

Just as Chen Guiliang took it, Director Sun pulled out a lighter.

"Director Sun, you're so enthusiastic, I'm almost afraid to smoke this cigarette," Chen Guiliang said, not knowing whether to laugh or cry.

Sun Yuejin said with a smile, "Go ahead and smoke. I won't make any requests, nor will I force you to invest in building up your hometown. Of course, if Boss Chen has a suitable project, you could certainly consider setting it up in our High-Tech Zone."

Yu Jianguo explained the situation from the side, "Last January, the state cracked down on reckless construction, and many High-Tech Zones across the country were shut down. But our Longdu's High-Tech Zone was kept, and its administrative area was even expanded."

Chen Guiliang thought to himself: One that slipped through the net.

The High-Tech Zone here had been established for over ten years, and its only noteworthy move was cooperating with a swindler in the 90s to pull off a backdoor listing that caused a national sensation. A supplementary condition was to have that swindler build a software industrial park.

The swindler did indeed build it, but only on paper.

It wasn't that the local leaders were easily deceived. At that time, the swindler was already famous throughout the country and had even built a software park and a software training school in Modu. If it weren't for a company here that could be used for a backdoor listing, he wouldn't have even bothered to come all this way to run a scam.

In recent years, although the High-Tech Zone couldn't attract any companies to set up shop, it had been vigorously engaged in real estate development.

However, they knew how to do proper business too. Using the real estate income, they were investing in and building an industrial park.

The problem was, who would be willing to invest and build a factory here?

Once the industrial park was built, only some small local businesses moved in due to tax incentives.

Sun Yuejin said, "We've set up an industrial park in the suburbs, and the demolition and relocation work is all done. We'll start leveling the land this year. Taxes are waived for three years and halved for the next two. If Boss Chen is interested, you can go take a look some other day."

There was no need to look. In seven or eight years, when the expressway opened, that place would only start to see a bit of life. It did indeed attract some factories from other places to relocate.

Before the expressway was built, only a fool would come here to invest.

Chen Guiliang gave a perfunctory reply, "Then I'll go have a look when I have time."

Sun Yuejin pressed his advantage, "Does Boss Chen have time this Spring Festival?"

"No, I have to rush back to Jingcheng," Chen Guiliang refused directly.

The smile on Sun Yuejin's face didn't falter as he continued to chat idly with Chen Guiliang. Securing an investment would be a pleasant surprise, but even if he couldn't, getting to know a big boss was still good.

Other relatives from the city would walk over from time to time, wearing broad smiles and saying flattering things.

Chen Guiliang just smiled.

As for the great-aunt who had just come over, Chen Guiliang had a particularly vivid memory of her.

One New Year's, the great-aunt gave his younger cousin Chen Guirong 10 yuan as lucky money, and Chen Guiliang happened to see it. Feeling that she would lose face, the great-aunt also gave Chen Guiliang some lucky money. But she only gave him fifty cents.

Chen Guiliang went home happily with the money. When his mother found out what happened, she dragged him back to return the money to the great-aunt. The great-aunt wouldn't take it, so his mother threw the money on the ground.

At that time, Chen Guiliang bawled his eyes out, crying his heart out, because fifty cents was a huge sum of money to him.

There were many things he would remember for a lifetime.

Of course, there was no need to fall out with them. His dad was currently enjoying the flattery from the city relatives, so he would just let his dad be happy.

After lunch, Yu Jianguo and Sun Yuejin took him fishing.

Chen Guiliang readily agreed. The fishpond was contracted by his maternal uncle anyway, so it wouldn't be bad to generate some income for his uncle.

After fishing for a good part of the afternoon, Director Sun finally had to leave.

Before he left, he again talked about the conveniences of the industrial park, hoping Chen Guiliang would consider it in the future.

Chen Guiliang cut straight to the chase, "Right now, all the land by the river in the city has been returned to forest, and a good portion has been collectively converted to growing Tianma bamboo. Come summer, there are more bamboo shoots than we can eat. If the expressway is ever built, I could set up a factory for processing bamboo shoots, and have my dad be the factory director then."

When Director Sun heard the words "expressway," the smile on his face became a little helpless.

He went everywhere to attract investment, but all the bosses would ask if there was an expressway.

"Boss Chen is a straight talker, so I won't disturb you any longer," Sun Yuejin said. "The day they start building the expressway, I'll be the first to notify Boss Chen."

Chen Guiliang shook his hand and said, "Take care, Director Sun."

The next morning, the village party secretary came with the town leaders to offer New Year's greetings.

Chen Guiliang had no choice but to receive them warmly. After lunch, he quickly slipped away, having Yang Shuo drive over to pick up Bian Guanyue with him.

If he didn't leave soon, who knows who else might come to visit.

Bian Guanyue's maternal grandparents came downstairs carrying large and small bags. They were all local specialty products, mostly food. The guys back at the dorm were in for a treat.

"Aren't you going back to say goodbye to Grandma?" Bian Guanyue asked.

Chen Guiliang said, "We'll come again next year. I'm so sick of all the New Year's visitors. If we go back to the village now, some other relative will probably show up. My dad is all about face, so I'll just let him handle the guests at home."

Bian Guanyue said, "Your family is quite interesting. The clothes your parents wear, and your mom's hairstyle, they remind me of old Hong Kong movies from the 80s."

"I really admire them. I have no idea where they buy those clothes. Most people really couldn't find them," Chen Guiliang grumbled.

Bian Guanyue laughed at his words, then asked, "Was Grandma the daughter of a prominent family back in the day?"

Chen Guiliang shook his head, "Not really. Grandma's father was a salt smuggler. He put together a fleet of boats specifically for smuggling salt. The fleet was all just modified small fishing boats, and I heard it was a share-holding syndicate. They were a small-time operation, responsible for transporting salt to Lushi to sell to the real salt kingpins there. And on the way back, they'd bring some things to sell."

There were more than a few of these small salt smuggling syndicates during the War of Resistance.

With the coastal salt-producing areas having fallen, Longdu's salt had to supply seven provinces, which gave rise to a large number of small private salt syndicates.

They were also bombed heavily by the little devils; the planes would bomb any derrick over a salt well they saw.

When Feng Yuxiang came to call for donations for the war effort, the people of Longdu, incensed by the bombings, donated 120 million fabi in one go. And over those eight years, the total national donation for the war was only 1.3 billion fabi.

In addition, they donated 120 aircraft, 1100 liang of gold, an unknown amount of silver, and a large quantity of salt to support the front lines.

That was when Great-Grandmother's gold and silver jewelry was donated.

The two chatted for a while. Yang Shuo drove into the city, passing the words "Return Our Lands," which were handwritten by Feng Yuxiang and carved into the rock face of the riverbank.

After leaving the city and getting on the provincial road, the car began to jolt violently.

It was all winding mountain roads.

Bouncing along, Chen Guiliang and Bian Guanyue ended up leaning against each other and falling asleep, leaving only poor Yang Shuo to continue driving.

Yang Shuo had also returned home in style this year, and some relatives had even tried to set him up on blind dates.

Working for a big company in Jingcheng, after all.

In the past, he definitely would have gone on the blind date, but now he looked down on it a bit. His dream was to marry a local Jingcheng girl.

Halfway there, Chen Guiliang's text message tone rang incessantly.

Chen Guiliang glanced at it, replied to two messages, and put his phone away.

They were from Tao Xue.

Chen Guiliang had been too naive before, thinking two women could coexist peacefully. Having learned his lesson, he now firmly forbade them from meeting, and wouldn't even call or text one in front of the other.

Bian Guanyue had woken up too. Guessing it was Tao Xue, she said resignedly, "Go ahead and reply. I'm going back to sleep for a bit."

Tao Xue: "Spending the New Year in Hangcheng is so boring. My brother is really something. He's gotten so cocky since becoming a big boss, bringing my parents to his new house in Hangcheng for the New Year."

Chen Guiliang: "Your parents must be happy. Their son is successful, after all."

Tao Xue: "They are indeed happy. They even went to visit West Lake a couple of days ago."

Chen Guiliang: "Haha, when they go back home, they'll be able to brag to relatives and friends for a whole year about spending the New Year in Hangcheng."

Tao Xue: "My brother also wants to move my parents to Hangcheng to live permanently. My parents are dead set against it, saying they can't get used to the food there, it's like it has no salt."

Chen Guiliang: "Can't be helped. We produce salt here, so of course we have to use it liberally. It all adds up to a heavy palate."

The two of them kept texting back and forth.

Bian Guanyue sat beside them, pretending to be asleep. As she slept, she started to feel very annoyed and pinched Chen Guiliang's thigh through his pants.

After pinching him, she went back to sleep.

Chen Guiliang was actually quite happy to be pinched. It was good that Bian Guanyue knew how to vent. He was afraid she would always keep things bottled up inside.

They drove to Rongcheng, returned the car to the Bian family, and the three of them flew to Jingcheng.

Yang Shuo went back to his rented apartment, eagerly turning on his computer to chat online.

The guy was currently in an online relationship with a girl from the suburbs of Jingcheng, whom he had met through a local search on Hainei. They had already met offline, and both felt pretty good about it.

If it were a few years later, this marriage would probably be a long shot. Once the girl's family's house in the inner suburbs got demolished...

Chen Guiliang and Bian Guanyue went to their own place.

As soon as they got inside, Bian Guanyue took out the sausages, cured meat, and other things her grandmother had packed for them.

"No, I'm about to puke from eating all that over the New Year. Just stir-frying a couple of vegetable dishes will be fine today," Chen Guiliang quickly stopped her.

Bian Guanyue smiled, "Then let's go to the wet market to buy vegetables together."

She really enjoyed the process of grocery shopping together.

After returning hand-in-hand from the market, Chen Guiliang was about to go into the kitchen to cook, but Bian Guanyue pushed him out, saying, "I know your cooking is better, but you have to give me a chance to practice more. Go watch TV and wait."

Chen Guiliang smiled.

Bian Guanyue was enjoying the fun of being a housewife.

It was like playing house.

Chen Guiliang went back to the living room and sat down. He didn't turn on the TV, but instead sent a text to Lü Zhihui, the person in charge of the IPO: "I'm back in Jingcheng."

Lü Zhihui called immediately, "The initial due diligence and planning will probably take another half a month to complete, as it involves several companies. For the next period, the team of accountants will need to be at the company three or four days a week. For two to three months before submitting the application, they will be stationed at the company full-time."

Lü Zhihui and the team from the accounting firm had already moved into the company before the New Year and had been busy throughout the Spring Festival. On the first day of the New Year, some even flew to Modu and Hangcheng.

Chen Guiliang had also specially contacted Peking University to set aside some of the dorm rooms prepared for exchange personnel for the accountants' temporary lodging.

Chen Guiliang said, "Thank you for your hard work. When I get back to the company, I'll give everyone a red envelope."

Lü Zhihui laughed, "Those few Americans on the team won't understand what a red envelope is. If it's taken as a tip, I wonder if anyone will get angry."

"Just tell them it's like the presents you put in stockings for Christmas," Chen Guiliang said.

Lü Zhihui roared with laughter, "That's a great idea. CEO Chen is their Santa Claus."

The IPO preparations were progressing well, with no major problems discovered so far.

(Many of the people and events are real, including Great-Grandmother. It's not convenient to write about my mother's side. Ever since I was little, I've heard my uncle say that he's from the same ancestral hall as Sister Jiang, and by generation, he should call her Great-Aunt. The one from Red Crag.)
